museum_text.en:
Dong Qichang radically transforms the landscape composition into a purely abstract design. He organizes the mountain forms to achieve an overall sense of structure, activating the flow of energy (qi) and the momentum of force (shi) throughout the pictorial design. In his art, brush and ink assume life independent of the depicted forms, so that the painting can be appreciated for “the sheer marvels of brush and ink.”

Dong Qichang had visited the Bian Mountains, which are part of a low range located not far from Wuxing and Lake Tai in the southern province of Zhejiang.

intro.zh: 董其昌（1555–1636）是晚明的画家、书法家、艺术理论家和官员，他的理论深深影响了清代的画家。
intro.en: Dong Qichang (1555–1636) was a painter, calligrapher, art theorist and official of the late Ming, whose theories strongly influenced painters of the Qing.

intro.zh: 1617年夏天，他画了青弁山，送给他的前辈张慎其。
intro.en: In the summer of 1617 he painted the Qingbian Mountains and sent the scroll to his senior, Zhang Shenqi.

intro.zh: 他的题字说，这是仿“北苑”，即十世纪的大师董源的笔意。
intro.en: His inscription says it is in the manner of Beiyuan, that is, the tenth-century master Dong Yuan.

intro.zh: 馆方说，他经营山形以求整体的结构感，让笔墨本身获得独立于物象的生命。
intro.en: The museum says he organised the mountain forms for an overall sense of structure, so that brush and ink take on a life independent of the things they depict.

look_for.zh: 弁山是太湖边、吴兴附近的一列低山，董其昌曾亲自去过。
look_for.en: The Bian Mountains, a low range near Wuxing and Lake Tai, which Dong had visited himself.

look_for.zh: 山石之间的树木和房屋。
look_for.en: Trees and houses among the rocks.
Dong Qichang's inscription at the top.

alt.zh: 一幅高大的水墨立轴：层层叠叠、折转的山体，中间有树木和小房屋，顶部有题字。
alt.en: A tall hanging scroll in ink: stacked, folding mountain masses with trees and small houses, and an inscription at the top.

views.zh: 馆方认为，董其昌把山水构图彻底改造成一种纯粹抽象的设计。
views.en: The museum argues that Dong radically transformed the landscape composition into a purely abstract design.

views.zh: 据维基百科引述，此书称董其昌是第一位不只是罗列、评定画家等级的艺术史家。
views.en: As quoted by Wikipedia, it calls Dong the first art historian to do more than list and grade artists.

quote.en: the first art historian to do more than list and grade artists

note.zh: 每一句都对照所注出处核对过；找不到可靠出处的说法已删去或改写。
note.en: Every sentence was checked against the sources it cites; claims without a reliable source were cut or rewritten.
